content: Hi how can i assist you today
My phone’s photo app keeps surfacing memories of a person the exact day I think about them. It feels targeted to my thoughts.
Memory surfacing often uses dates, locations, faces, and message history. Were those memories taken around this week in past years or tied to common places?
Yes, same month a few years back, and many were at the park near me.
That matches typical triggers. If you check the ‘Why am I seeing this?’ or info panel on a memory, it usually lists the rule—date, place, or people tags.
I didn’t know there was an info panel.
It’s often behind an ⓘ icon. Comparing two surfaced memories with their info can show whether timing is due to anniversary dates or frequent locations.
I’ll look at the details next time it pops up.
